papers.title: [Selenium-containing polyurethane-modified titanium modulates osteogenic differentiation of mesenchymal stem cells and M2 polarization of macrophages].
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: To address the issue of implant failure in clinical titanium implants due to inflammation, disease microenvironments, poor osseointegration through surface modification, and to explore the regulatory effects of selenium-containing biomaterial-modified titanium on the osteogenic differentiation of rat bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (rBMMSCs) and the M2 polarization of RAW 264.7 cells. METHODS: Selenium-containing polyurethane (SePU) was synthesized, and titanium sheets were modified by immersion in SePU solutions at concentrations of 1, 3, and 5 g/L. Pure titanium sheets served as the control group. rBMMSCs and RAW 264.7 cells were then cultured on the modified titanium surfaces. The surface contact angles of the SePU-modified titanium sheets were characterized. After 2 days of culture, the effect of SePU-modified titanium on the viability of rBMMSCs and RAW 264.7 cells was observed using live/dead cell staining. The osteogenic differentiation of rBMMSCs was evaluated using alkaline phosphatase (ALP) staining and quantification, alizarin red S (ARS) staining and quantification, as well as the expression levels of osteogenic-related genes. The polarization state of RAW 264.7 cells was assessed by analyzing the expression levels of macrophage polarization-related genes. RESULTS: SePU-modified titanium sheets were successfully prepared and their surface contact angles increased with the immersion concentration. Following 2 days of culture, the majority of rBMMSCs and RAW 264.7 cells on both the pure titanium and SePU-modified titanium surfaces were viable, with only a negligible presence of dead cells. Notably, compared with the pure titanium group, the SePU-modified titanium groups exhibited more profound ALP and ARS staining, coupled with a statistically significant increase in the expression levels of osteogenic-related genes (P < 0.05). Among these groups, the 3 g/L group showed the deepest ALP staining and the most significant increase in osteogenic-related gene expression. Furthermore, the SePU-modified titanium groups displayed decreased expression of proinflammatory genes and increased expression of anti-inflammatory genes compared with the unmodified pure titanium group, with statistically significant differences (P < 0.05). The 3 g/L group exhibited the most significant effect among the modified titanium groups. CONCLUSION: SePU-modified titanium not only exhibits increased surface contact angles but also has no significant effect on cell viability. It effectively promotes the osteogenic differentiation of rBMMSCs and the M2 polarization of RAW 264.7 cells, indicating its potential for enhancing bone regeneration and modulating immune responses in biomedical applications.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文通过硒代聚氨酯涂层改性钛表面促进成骨与巨噬细胞M2极化，属于钛植入物表面生物功能化，与增材制造多孔结构、应力遮挡或LPBF力学测试无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper uses dip-coated selenium-containing polyurethane on solid titanium sheets with only in vitro cell assays; it does not involve LPBF/AM fabrication, porous lattice design, stress shielding or stiffness matching, fatigue or mechanical testing, or osseointegration in vivo.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决钛植入物因炎症和骨整合差导致的临床失效问题。
summary_zh.method: 合成含硒聚氨酯并浸涂改性钛片，与大鼠骨髓间充质干细胞和巨噬细胞共培养。
summary_zh.result: 3 g/L组显著促进成骨分化并诱导M2极化，且不影响细胞活性。
summary_zh.validation: 接触角表征及体外细胞染色、基因表达检测。

summary_en.motivation: To mitigate clinical titanium implant failure caused by inflammation, hostile disease microenvironments, and insufficient osseointegration.
summary_en.method: Selenium-containing polyurethane was synthesized and dip-coated onto titanium sheets at varying concentrations, followed by co-culture with rat bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells and RAW 264.7 macrophages.
summary_en.result: The 3 g/L coating group most strongly enhanced osteogenic gene expression and shifted macrophages toward an anti-inflammatory M2 phenotype without compromising cell viability.
summary_en.validation: Surface contact angle characterization plus in vitro live/dead staining, ALP and alizarin red assays, and gene expression analysis.

papers.title: Preoperative whey protein and exercise ımprove early recovery after total hip arthroplasty: a randomized controlled trial
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Total hip arthroplasty (THA) is an effective surgical procedure for treating hip osteoarthritis; however, postoperative recovery may be complicated by impaired functional capacity, delayed mobilization, and prolonged hospital stay. Preoperative multimodal strategies combining nutritional support and exercise may improve recovery outcomes. Objective This study aimed to evaluate the effects of a combined multimodal prehabilitation protocol (preoperative whey protein supplementation plus structured exercise) on metabolic parameters, functional independence, and length of hospital stay in patients undergoing THA. Methods This randomized controlled trial included 71 patients scheduled for total hip arthroplasty (THA). Participants were randomly assigned to either the intervention group (n = 36), which received a 14-day preoperative program consisting of oral whey protein supplementation (25 g/day) and a partially supervised, home-based structured exercise protocol (comprising an initial face-to-face instruction followed by telephone-guided monitoring), or the control group (n = 35), which received standard care. Baseline habitual physical activity levels were recorded for both groups. Data were collected preoperatively and on postoperative days 3 and 5. Functional outcomes were assessed using the Barthel Index, while biochemical markers included C-reactive protein (CRP) and albumin levels. Statistical analyses included ANCOVA (adjusting for age and chronic diseases) and Repeated-Measures ANOVA for longitudinal markers. Results Significant Group × Time interaction effects were observed for CRP ( p < 0.001) and albumin ( p = 0.008), indicating different postoperative trajectories between the intervention and control groups. After adjustment for age and chronic disease status, the intervention group demonstrated significantly higher Barthel Index scores than the control group ( p < 0.001; ηp 2 = 0.31), with a large standardized between-group effect (Cohen’s d = 1.59). Length of hospital stay was significantly shorter in the intervention group (5.11 ± 1.38 vs. 6.94 ± 1.72 days); this difference remained statistically significant after adjustment for age and chronic disease status ( p = 0.004). Conclusion Combined preoperative multimodal prehabilitation integrating whey protein supplementation with structured exercise demonstrates promising efficacy in improving early functional recovery and reducing length of hospital stay in patients undergoing THA. While baseline imbalances necessitate a cautious interpretation of the effect magnitude, this integrated strategy shows strong clinical potential for perioperative optimization. Trial registration : The study was registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (Identifier: NCT07329010) on 25 September 2025.
papers.venue: Journal of Orthopaedic Surgery and Research

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文是髋关节置换围手术期营养与运动康复的临床试验，与股骨柄生物力学、应力遮挡或有限元分析无关。
llm.why_not_core: This is a clinical prehabilitation RCT with no biomechanical modeling, no femoral stem stress-shielding or micromotion analysis, no FEA, and no implant design or boundary-condition data.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索术前营养与运动联合干预能否改善全髋置换患者术后恢复。
summary_zh.method: 71例患者随机分为术前14天乳清蛋白加家庭运动组与常规护理组，比较功能与生化指标。
summary_zh.result: 干预组Barthel指数更高、CRP与白蛋白变化更优、住院时间更短。
summary_zh.validation: 随机对照临床试验，术后第3、5天随访评估。

summary_en.motivation: The study examines whether a combined preoperative nutritional and exercise program can accelerate recovery after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Seventy-one THA candidates were randomized to a 14-day whey protein plus structured home exercise protocol or standard care, with functional and biochemical outcomes compared.
summary_en.result: The intervention group showed higher Barthel Index scores, more favorable CRP and albumin trajectories, and shorter hospital stays than controls.
summary_en.validation: A randomized controlled clinical trial with postoperative assessments on days 3 and 5.

papers.title: ADAPTIVE LIGHTWEIGHT STRUCTURAL DESIGN FRAMEWORK FOR ALUMINIUM TRAILER PLATFORMS USING MULTI-OBJECTIVE FINITE ELEMENT OPTIMIZATION AND MANUFACTURABILITY CONSTRAINTS
papers.abstract: Adaptive lightweight design of aluminum trailer platforms is technically significant, as road-load requirements, payload, stiffness, fatigue, buckling, and manufacturability requirements often conflict. The review critically summarizes the published journal literature concerning multi-objective finite element optimization, manufacturing-oriented topology optimization, joining of aluminum, stress/buckling control and lightweight vehicle-related structural design. The literature review demonstrates that effective lightweight designs were not necessarily achieved by minimizing weight, but rather by considering the following factors: load-path continuity, minimum member size, weld access, structural feasibility of the trailer platform, interaction between the deck and the trailer platform, fatigue-prone details and the avoidance of local buckling. Existing research is well-grounded in the computational aspects, but is scattered over vehicle crashworthiness, aerospace topology optimization, additive manufacturing limitations, and general aluminum fabrication research. Validation of trailers, multi-objective optimization considering fatigue and the rules of manufacture of welded and extruded aluminum remain insufficiently developed. Such a framework should therefore integrate finite element fidelity, surrogate model adaptation, manufacturable geometry production, and production-based constraint screening.
papers.venue: World Journal of Advanced Engineering Technology and Sciences

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文是铝制拖车平台轻量化设计的综述，涉及多目标有限元优化与可制造性约束，与FEA代理建模方向仅有间接背景关联。
llm.why_not_core: This is a literature review on trailer platform lightweight design with no surrogate model development, no uncertainty quantification, and no biomedical or implant mechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 铝制拖车平台轻量化需平衡刚度、疲劳、屈曲与可制造性等冲突目标。
summary_zh.method: 综述多目标有限元优化、面向制造拓扑优化及铝连接与屈曲控制文献。
summary_zh.result: 指出有效轻量化依赖载荷路径连续性与可制造约束，而非单纯减重。
summary_zh.validation: 文献综述，无实验或数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Lightweight aluminium trailer platforms must reconcile conflicting road-load, stiffness, fatigue, buckling, and manufacturability requirements.
summary_en.method: The authors critically review published literature on multi-objective finite element optimization, manufacturing-oriented topology optimization, aluminium joining, and stress/buckling control.
summary_en.result: The review concludes that effective lightweighting depends on load-path continuity, minimum member size, weld access, and buckling avoidance rather than weight minimization alone.
summary_en.validation: This is a narrative literature review without experimental or numerical validation.

papers.title: UNCERTAINTY QUANTIFICATION AND CARRIER-COLLECTION ROBUSTNESS UNDER PHYSICAL TOLERANCES IN A SERIES VERTICAL-JUNCTION SILICON SOLAR CELL
papers.abstract: This work investigates the propagation of uncertainties in physical parameters to carrier collection in a series vertical-junction silicon solar cell. Starting from an exact dimensionless collection law, uncertainties are introduced in the base thickness H, diffusion coefficient D, carrier lifetime τ, and interface recombination velocities Sf and Sb. For each realization, the diffusion length and the reduced parameters h, f, and b are recalculated, thereby preserving the dependencies induced by the physical transformation. Twenty-seven nominal regimes and four controlled uncertainty amplitudes, from ±5% to ±30%, are investigated using a Monte Carlo campaign of 120,000 realizations per scenario. Robustness is characterized by the coefficient of variation of collection and by R90 = P(C ≥ 0.9 C0). The median coefficient of variation increases from approximately 3.13% at ±5% to 18.94% at ±30%, while the maximum value reaches 37.14%. Over the same range, the median R90 decreases from 100% to approximately 68.12%. At ±30%, some regimes retain R90 close to unity, whereas the least robust regime in the grid reaches approximately 60.17%. The regime of maximum statistical dispersion does not exactly coincide with that of minimum R90. These results show that nominal performance, statistical dispersion, and probabilistic robustness are distinct properties and establish a regime-dependent map for assessing collection robustness under controlled physical uncertainty.
papers.venue: World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文用蒙特卡洛做参数不确定性传播，与FEA代理模型中的UQ思路可类比，但应用对象是太阳能电池载流子收集，与植入物/生物力学无关。
llm.why_not_core: It performs Monte Carlo UQ on an analytical solar-cell collection law with no FEA, no surrogate model, no implant or biomechanics context, and no constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化物理参数不确定性对太阳能电池载流子收集的影响。
summary_zh.method: 基于无量纲收集律，对厚度、扩散系数、寿命和界面复合速度做蒙特卡洛抽样传播。
summary_zh.result: 变异系数随扰动幅度从约3%升至19%，R90从100%降至约68%，且离散度最大与鲁棒性最差的工况不一致。
summary_zh.validation: 27个名义工况、4档扰动幅度、每场景12万次蒙特卡洛仿真。

summary_en.motivation: The study aims to quantify how physical parameter uncertainty propagates into carrier collection in a vertical-junction silicon solar cell.
summary_en.method: An exact dimensionless collection law is combined with Monte Carlo sampling over base thickness, diffusion coefficient, lifetime, and interface recombination velocities, recomputing derived parameters per realization.
summary_en.result: Median coefficient of variation rises from about 3% to 19% as uncertainty grows from ±5% to ±30%, while median R90 falls from 100% to roughly 68%, with dispersion and robustness optima not coinciding.
summary_en.validation: A Monte Carlo campaign of 120,000 realizations across 27 nominal regimes and four uncertainty amplitudes.
